anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: First month and beginning of months heard by the perfect.

pass_a_gloss: Such are those able, still being in the world, to hear a first month and beginning of months to have come to be for them.
pass_b_english: Such are those who, while still in the world, are able to hear that a first month and a beginning of months have come to be for them.
source_text: Τοιοῦ[τοι δ[ὲ] οἱ δυνάμ[ενοι ἔτι] ἐν κ[όσμῳ] ὄντες ἀκούειν [πρ]ῶτον [μῆ]να καὶ ἀρχὴν μ[ην]ῶν αὐ[τοῖς] γεγον<έν>αι.
